_schema.description: Tarte supplier order forms — single source of truth. Consumers (TK ApprovedSupplierItem, printable forms, Cowork cheatsheet & per-supplier forms) all read from here. Per-item "active": true means we currently order this from this supplier; "active": false means it is on their book but we have chosen another source. Bidfood line items show GROSS price — apply supplier.rebatePct/100 to get our effective cost.

fields.cutoff: Order cutoff time relative to delivery
fields.item.active: true = ordering active. false = on book but not chosen.
fields.item.packPrice: Per-pack price ex GST (gross — apply rebate at comparison time)
fields.item.unitPrice: Per-base-unit price (per kg / L / each). Gross.

_notes: Verified line-by-line against invoices to 1 Oct 2026 (2 Oct pass: 1,693 lines since 25 Aug). This file is the authoritative source. Prices are per pack ex GST; Bidfood gross before the 4% rebate.
